notes: PUC CallInfo is 64 B on this ABI (gcc-measured against lua-5.5.0/src/lstate.h). luazig CallFrame is 88 B in BOTH modes — P16.20 T1 made the layout build-mode-stable (extern struct/union; was Debug 104 vs RF 96 before), and P16.20 T3 then removed the stored `base` field (invariant base == func_slot + 1, derived via frameBase()), shrinking 96 -> 88 B. P16.30 Stage C replaced `toclose_base` with `parked_stack` 8B-for-8B (suspended C-frames keep their c_stack for the thread-owned TBC chain), CallFrame stayed 88 B (comptime assert vm.zig). luazig frames carry architecture-specific state (iterative yieldable execution, inline hook-replay PCs, simple-result continuation, activation_id); 64 B is NOT a target — the model is. P16.31 T0 regeneration on P16.30-final source: all values re-measured via standalone Zig probe (Debug + ReleaseFast, identical) and gcc probe for PUC; field offsets added.
